result.stdout:
Usage:
  lidguard <command> [options]
  lidguard help <command>
  lidguard <command> --help

Session Control:
  start
    Start or refresh a tracked session and load the saved default settings.

  stop
    Stop a tracked session by matching the same provider and session identity used when the session started.

  remove-session
    Remove active sessions currently tracked by the runtime.

  status
    Show runtime state, active sessions, and effective stored settings.

  live-status
    Show a live terminal dashboard for runtime state, active sessions, and recent LidGuard flow logs.

  cleanup-orphans
    Remove sessions whose watched processes have already exited.

  help
    Show the categorized command overview or focused detailed help for one known command or alias.

Settings & Suspend:
  settings
    Show and update the default settings used when sessions start.

  remove-pre-suspend-webhook
    Clear the saved before sleep or hibernate webhook URL.

  remove-post-session-end-webhook
    Clear the saved session completion webhook URL.

  preview-system-sound
    Play one supported SystemSound name now, using the saved temporary volume setting.

  preview-current-sound
    Play the saved sleep or hibernate warning sound now, using the saved temporary volume setting.

Diagnostics:
  current-lid-state
    Report the current lid switch state using the same platform lid-state source LidGuard uses for closed-lid policy decisions.

  current-monitor-count
    Report the current visible display monitor count using the same base platform monitor visibility check LidGuard uses for closed-lid policy decisions.

  current-temperature
    Report the current system temperature in Celsius using the selected temperature mode.

  suspend-history
    Print recent sleep/hibernate request history from the local history log.

  linux-permission
    Inspect or manage Linux polkit permissions for systemd/logind suspend and inhibitor operations.

Hook Integration:
  hook-status
    Inspect the managed hook configuration for one prov
[truncated]
